Run retrospective motion correction

Source: R/volreg.R
volreg.Rd

Run retrospective motion correction

Usage

volreg(
  x,
  mask = NULL,
  ref = c("middle", "robust_mean", "index"),
  ref_index = NULL,
  engine = c("rigid_robust", "rigid_spline"),
  slice_times = NULL,
  mb_groups = NULL,
  resample = TRUE,
  interp_final = c("bspline", "lanczos", "linear"),
  qc = TRUE,
  control = volreg_control(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

4D image-like input.

mask

Optional 3D mask.

ref

Reference strategy.

ref_index

Explicit reference index for ref='index'.

engine

Motion engine.

slice_times

Optional slice timing offsets.

mb_groups

Optional multiband group IDs.

resample

If TRUE, apply estimated motion to generate corrected output.

interp_final

Final interpolation method.

qc

If TRUE, compute QC metrics.

control

Control list.

verbose

Verbose logging.

Value

A volregger_fit object.
